app_info.subtitle: Create indoor bike workouts
app_info.description: BullWatt helps users find structured indoor cycling workouts, validate FTP-based workout plans, and save valid sessions for use in the BullWatt browser app.

justifications.read_only_justification: Searches the existing BullWatt workout catalog and returns matching summaries without changing stored data.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only reads BullWatt's private server-side catalog and does not change public or third-party systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform any irreversible action.

justifications.read_only_justification: Computes validation results and workout metrics from the supplied training without storing or modifying it.
justifications.open_world_justification: Performs local deterministic validation without contacting or changing external systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform any irreversible action.

justifications.read_only_justification: Creates a new generated workout file after validation and returns a URL for opening it in BullWatt.
justifications.open_world_justification: Creates a workout that is accessible through a newly generated BullWatt web URL.
justifications.destructive_justification: Always assigns a random new identifier and does not delete or overwrite existing workouts.

test_cases.description: Find short workouts that fit a limited training window.
test_cases.user_prompt: Find BullWatt workouts between 30 and 45 minutes long.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns matching catalog workouts with their names, durations, phase counts, and intensity metrics.

test_cases.description: Find workouts matching a training style and intensity ceiling.
test_cases.user_prompt: Find threshold workouts whose maximum intensity does not exceed 100% FTP.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns only catalog workouts matching the threshold terms and requested maximum FTP ratio.

test_cases.description: Validate a correctly structured generated workout.
test_cases.user_prompt: Validate this BullWatt workout: {"id":"easy-ride","training_name":"Easy Ride","description":"A short recovery ride.","duration":600,"units":{"time":"seconds","ftp_ratio":"number"},"phases":[{"start":0,"ftp_ratio":0.5,"notes":"Easy riding"},{"start":600,"ftp_ratio":0,"notes":"End"}]}
test_cases.expected_output: Reports that the workout is valid and returns its calculated duration and intensity metrics.

test_cases.description: Reject a workout with phases in an invalid chronological order.
test_cases.user_prompt: Validate this BullWatt workout and explain any blocking errors: {"id":"bad-order","training_name":"Bad Order","description":"Test invalid phase order.","duration":600,"units":{"time":"seconds","ftp_ratio":"number"},"phases":[{"start":0,"ftp_ratio":0.5},{"start":300,"ftp_ratio":0.8},{"start":200,"ftp_ratio":0.5}]}
test_cases.expected_output: Reports that the workout is invalid and identifies the non-increasing phase start as a blocking error.

test_cases.description: Save a valid workout and provide a practice link.
test_cases.user_prompt: Save this valid BullWatt workout so I can practice it: {"id":"recovery-spin","training_name":"Recovery Spin","description":"A gentle recovery session.","duration":600,"units":{"time":"seconds","ftp_ratio":"number"},"phases":[{"start":0,"ftp_ratio":0.5,"notes":"Easy riding"},{"start":600,"ftp_ratio":0,"notes":"End"}]}
test_cases.expected_output: Confirms that the workout was saved under a new identifier and provides its BullWatt practice URL.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for analysis of completed ride data.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Analyze my completed ride file and tell me how my heart rate changed over time.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because it does not analyze completed activities or heart-rate files.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for live smart-trainer control.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Set my smart trainer resistance to 250 watts right now.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because its MCP tools do not directly control connected fitness hardware.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for medical clearance or diagnosis.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Is interval training medically safe for my heart condition?
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because technical workout validation is not medical advice or medical clearance.
